upheld.title: Non-retrying aria-current check after enhanced navigation in TC-07
upheld.detail: After clicking a product card, the test polls only the URL and then reads aria-current once with getAttribute. Blazor enhanced navigation can push the URL before patching the DOM, so the read may still see the catalog header (aria-current="page") and fail at random. It can only fail falsely, never p
upheld.requirement: On every other page (a product page...) it has no aria-current.

upheld.title: Inconsistent BASE_URL! non-null assertion
upheld.detail: The spec writes `BASE_URL!` at two sites, while the rest of the same file and every sibling teststack spec use plain BASE_URL. It works the same at run time but mixes two conventions in one file.
upheld.requirement: One BASE_URL convention (.factory/lessons/test-automation.md L21); match the neighbours (prb-2.spec.ts:30)

upheld.title: Duplicated aria-current assertion in TC-PRB-10-01
upheld.detail: `await expect(shopAll(page)).toHaveAttribute('aria-current', 'page')` is followed by `expect(await shopAll(page).getAttribute('aria-current')).toBe('page')`, which checks the same thing again without auto-wait.
